## Observation

On 2026-11-11 a live agentic run of `us.meta.llama4-maverick-17b-instruct-v1:0` on Bedrock (us-west-2) with rebar's default `max_tokens` (`DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 16000`, src/rebar/llm/config.py) was rejected before generation: HTTP 400 ValidationException "The maximum tokens you requested exceeds the model limit of 8192". The same run with `max_tokens=8192` completed. Found while fixing garlicky-leery-seal.

## Root cause (measured)

- rebar already clamps each request's output cap to a per-model ceiling: `structured_run` takes `min(effective cap, _known_model_output_ceiling(model))`, read from the single-source table `MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` in `src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py` (the Nova entries were added the same way, bug cumulative-insensible-asianlion). The review paths also RAISE to that ceiling through `model_max_output_tokens`.
- The table has no Llama 4 entry, so an unmapped Maverick keeps the 16000 default and Bedrock rejects every call.
- Probed directly with boto3 Converse on 2026-11-12 02:49 PST (us-west-2, frontier-bedrock): `us.meta.llama4-maverick-17b-instruct-v1:0` and `us.meta.llama4-scout-17b-instruct-v1:0` both accept maxTokens 8192 (`end_turn`) and reject 8193 and 16000 with "exceeds the model limit of 8192".

## Approach

Add `("llama4-maverick", 8_192)` and `("llama4-scout", 8_192)` to `MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`, with a comment citing the measurement. The lookup is a substring match, so both the `us.` inference-profile ids and bare ids match. No config key, env var or flag; no other behaviour changes.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py`
- `tests/unit/test_max_tokens_model_ceiling_1019.py`

## Testing

- RED then GREEN in `tests/unit/test_max_tokens_model_ceiling_1019.py`:
  - `model_max_output_tokens` returns 8192 for `bedrock:us.meta.llama4-maverick-17b-instruct-v1:0`, `us.meta.llama4-scout-17b-instruct-v1:0` and the bare ids (fails pre-fix: 16000).
  - The structured-run request settings for Maverick with the default 16000 cap carry `max_tokens == 8192` (the clamp path every run uses; fails pre-fix).
  - The existing Claude, Nova and unmapped-model rows are unchanged.
- Live: one PydanticAIRunner run of Maverick on Bedrock with the DEFAULT `max_tokens` completes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A test that fails on the pre-fix tree shows Llama 4 Maverick and Scout resolve to an 8192 output ceiling.
- [x] A test that fails on the pre-fix tree shows a Maverick request built from the default 16000 cap is sent with max_tokens 8192.
- [x] Existing ceiling rows (Claude, Nova, unmapped fallback) are unchanged, shown by the existing tests passing.
- [x] [non-codebase] A live PydanticAIRunner run of `us.meta.llama4-maverick-17b-instruct-v1:0` on Bedrock with the default max_tokens completes, recorded as a comment.
  provenance: environment=Bedrock us-west-2 via the frontier-bedrock profile from the fix-gecko worktree; principal=frontier-bedrock IAM identity; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — one runner call
- [x] [non-codebase] `env -u JIRA_URL -u JIRA_USER -u JIRA_API_TOKEN make verify` exits 0 on the commit pushed for review.
  provenance: environment=macOS dev host, fix-gecko worktree; principal=Rebar Bot Nava; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=live-call — exit status and log live outside the repository
